title: Sparkly mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='screen' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#5ec8ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3a6bff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='30' y='16' width='40' height='68' rx='8' fill='#7a4fd1'/>
  <!-- lighter edge of body -->
  <rect x='33' y='19' width='34' height='62' rx='6' fill='#a678ff'/>
  <!-- inner dark bezel -->
  <rect x='35' y='24' width='30' height='52' rx='4' fill='#2b1a55'/>
  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='37' y='27' width='26' height='46' rx='3' fill='url(#screen)'/>
  <!-- screen picture: simple sun -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='8' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='3' fill='#c9a8ff'/>
  <!-- speaker -->
  <rect x='46' y='20' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9a8ff'/>

  </g>
  <g fill='#9ef0ff'>
    <path d='M22 44 L23 48 L27 49 L23 50 L22 54 L21 50 L17 49 L21 48 Z'/>
    <path d='M78 42 L79 46 L83 47 L79 48 L78 52 L77 48 L73 47 L77 46 Z'/>

</svg>
